title: Apprentice model catalog
description: Contract for the published models.json. Hand written, not inferred from an instance: a field is required here only when the catalog genuinely cannot mean anything without it. The converter (scripts/catalog_publish) checks every published document against this file, so a field added to the Go struct set in internal/domain/modelcatalog without a matching change here fails the publish instead of shipping an undocumented key. Optional values are emitted as JSON null rather than omitted, because the Go structs deliberately carry no omitempty: an absent rate must stay distinguishable from a 0.00 rate on the billing path. Integer fields use minimum 0 because 0 is how the catalog says 'not stated', not a real limit.

schemaVersion.description: Catalog schema version. A build rejects a document declaring a version higher than the one it was compiled against.

updatedAt.description: Date the catalog data was last edited, ISO 8601 calendar date.

defaults.description: Values applied to any model that omits the field.

models.description: Canonical model entries, keyed by canonical vendor model id. Every provider model reference resolves against this map.

providers.description: Which models each provider exposes and how that list is obtained, keyed by provider id.

id.description: A model or provider id: non-empty, no surrounding or embedded whitespace. Vendor ids legitimately carry dots, colons, and slashes, so the pattern is deliberately wider than the current data.

effort.description: Reasoning-effort vocabulary. Must stay in step with knownEfforts in internal/domain/modelcatalog/validate.go.

optionalEffort.description: An effort token, or the empty string meaning the catalog states no default.

thinkingMode.description: Extended-thinking vocabulary. Must stay in step with knownThinkingModes in internal/domain/modelcatalog/validate.go.

rate.description: USD per million tokens. null means the catalog does not price this axis, which is not the same as a free 0.00 rate.

tokenCount.description: A token limit. 0 means the catalog states no limit.

label.description: Human-readable model name shown in the UI.

aliases.description: Additional exact ids the same model answers to. Exact alternative ids, never prefixes.

vendor.description: Vendor that owns the model, for example anthropic or openai.

supported.description: null means the catalog states nothing, which is not a denial. false is an explicit denial.

defaultEffort.description: Must be a member of this model's own efforts list. That cross-field rule is enforced by Validate in internal/domain/modelcatalog, which JSON Schema cannot express.

supported.description: null means the catalog states nothing, which is not a denial.

alwaysOn.description: null falls back to defaults.thinking.default rather than reading as false.

note.description: Free-text provenance or promotional note. Never parsed as data.

discovery.description: catalog means use the models list here. live means read the provider's own API at runtime and use fallbackModels only when it is unreachable.

reasoningTransport.description: How the effort reaches the provider, for example cli-flag for the Claude Code CLI.

models.description: Model ids exposed under catalog discovery. Every id must exist in the top-level models map; that referential rule is enforced by Validate in internal/domain/modelcatalog.

fallbackModels.description: Model ids used only when live discovery is unreachable. Same referential rule as models.
